caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
positive_analysis:
The white cords attached to the cylinder lengthen when tension increases beyond their resting state.
As pulling force grows, the cords extend toward maximum length while keeping attachment points continuous.
The orange anchor at top transmits stretch force downward to the suspended mass.

negative_analysis:
The black cylinder hangs from taut cables anchored above, staying suspended over the calm sea surface.
If the upper cables are eased, the cylinder descends gradually toward the water below.
Wind or cable motion would cause the suspended cylinder and raft to sway together.
The orange raft remains tethered near the top-left, separate from the cylinder's load.
